records.rule: Video and audio are separate browser capture resources; a VLC V4L2 preview does not prove virtual microphone capture.
Observed v4l2loopback device is /dev/video0; PipeWire PulseAudio sink service_audio and source service_mic. Never hardcode those as cross-host universal names.
Start the resident worker once; HOLD emits idle frames and silence at the normal clock instead of closing devices.
24 fps I420 output and 48 kHz stereo PCM imply 2,000 PCM stereo samples per output frame; measure live skew, do not infer it from offline byte counts.
Invoke native start explicitly by invokeArray because inherited ooRexx Object~start collides with the foreign name.
Size/symlink checks at enqueue and dequeue reject missing or malformed media, but do not attest content identity or block same-size swaps.
Intention != authorised projection; business services must supply validated data and session-granted fields before any presentation.
Dev3 PASS on native file-output + standards is not dev3 PASS on Firefox, PipeWire microphone or WhatsApp receiver.
Alchemy uses immutable autobuild-submit branches and acceptance receipts; a committed transport branch is not a main-branch merge.
